h: Osimhen reportedly scores twice as Galatasaray win the Istanbul derby against Fenerbahce
p: Victor Osimhen is reported to have scored two goals in Galatasaray's derby win over Fenerbahce, and the club's coach has since reacted to the result. Nigerian fans are celebrating the striker's performance online.
more: The match followed days of build-up around Osimhen's record against Fenerbahce.
Reactions from both sets of supporters are still coming in.
